budget_derivation: G4 final calibration used five independent 200-repetition batches after 20 warmups on each required CI execution surface. For each guarded path the frozen ceiling is the greatest directly measured max_ms across both lanes; no synthetic multiplier is added. Final regression checks compare a fresh p95 against that measured envelope.

environment_comparability.rule: Hard-field change requires versioned supersession. Rolling hosted image_version is exact provenance and remains performance-tested but is not alone a comparability break.
